remaining_gaps.title: Bringer same-Invader limit within one Power, across affected lands
remaining_gaps.literal_question: Bringer uses Tsunami with its threshold. Its base Damage would destroy a Town, so that Town is Pushed into an adjacent other Coastal land on the same board. Tsunami’s threshold later deals Damage in that land. Counting only nightmare-destruction Fear from that same Town, can it produce that Fear again during this single Tsunami use, or only once?
remaining_gaps.predetermined_answer: Only once. A single Power cannot pretend-destroy the same Invader more than once, even if it moves into another land later affected by that Power. The Town yields2nightmare Fear in total from this use, excluding Tsunami’s printed Fear.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Does this same Town produce nightmare-destruction Fear a second time during one Tsunami use?
required_facts: The same Town provides nightmare-destruction Fear only once during that single Tsunami use; moving it between affected lands does not reset the per-Power, per-Invader limit.

key_context_not_required.fact: A Town’s ordinary nightmare conversion is2Fear, so this Town contributes2rather than4.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The conversion amount is already directly asked byQ84; the new request is the once-per-piece limit, not a new numerical Fear calculation.

key_context_not_required.fact: A Repeat is a separate use and may pretend-destroy the piece again.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Already asked byQ82/Q83; no Repeat ask added.

key_context_not_required.fact: Tsunami’s printed Fear and all other Invaders are excluded from the requested total.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Do not demand an entire island Fear calculation or every Tsunami instruction.

producer_reachability_proof.legal_state: Ordinary two adjacent Coastal lands on the same balanced board; Town initially in the first; legal Bringer Sacred Site/Range and met Tsunami threshold stipulated. ordered_execution: Tsunami’s base8Damage would destroy the Town. Bringer’s printed replacement and FAQ .7w4g7yx give the nightmare Fear and Push whenever that destruction would occur.

This Push is the Power’s own conversion effect at the Damage instruction, not a delayed Vengeance-style after-Power triggered action. It occurs before continuing with the remaining base text and threshold.
The adjacent Coastal destination is an OTHER Coastal land on that same board, so the later printed threshold4Damage actually reaches that same physical Town.
The printed one-Power/one-Invader cap prevents a second nightmare-destruction reward. No new use or Repeat occurs.
producer_reachability_proof.timing_basis: The FAQ explicitly says Whenever it would destroy, in the real game earn Fear and Push; CORE orders the base text and threshold. This is source-based timing, not an unsupported narrated relocation.
producer_reachability_proof.Dahan_text: Bringer cannot Destroy Dahan; any Dahan lines do not create a separate Power use or invalidate the rest. Already tested byQ104 and not demanded anew.
